title: Scaling Sim-to-Real VLA Reinforcement Learning with Generative 3D Worlds
abstract: arXiv:2603.18532v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The strong performance of large vision-language models (VLMs) trained with reinforcement learning (RL) has motivated similar approaches for fine-tuning vision-language-action (VLA) models in robotics. Many recent works fine-tune VLAs directly in the real world to avoid addressing the sim-to-real gap. While real-world RL circumvents sim-to-real issues, it inherently limits the generality of the resulting VLA, as scaling scene and object diversity in the physical world is prohibitively difficult. This leads to the paradoxical outcome of transforming a broadly pretrained model into an overfitted, scene-specific policy. Training in simulation can instead provide access to diverse scenes, but designing those scenes is also costly. In this work, we show that VLAs can be RL fine-tuned across broad scene and object distributions and with reduced labor by leveraging 3D world generative models. translated_title: 利用生成式3D世界扩展Sim-to-Real VLA强化学习
translated_abstract: 通过强化学习（RL）训练的大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）所展现的强大性能，激发了在机器人领域采用类似方法微调视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的研究热潮。许多近期工作直接在真实世界中对VLA进行微调，以回避解决仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的差距问题。虽然真实世界强化学习规避了sim-to-real问题，但它本质上限制了所得VLA模型的泛化能力，因为在物理世界中扩展场景和物体的多样性是极其困难的。这导致了一个悖论式的结果：将一个经过广泛预训练的模型转变为过拟合的、特定于场景的策略。在仿真中训练反而可以提供多样化的场景，但设计这些场景的成本同样高昂。在这项工作中，我们展示了通过利用3D世界生成模型，VLA模型可以在广泛的场景和物体分布上进行强化学习微调，并显著减少人工投入。通过将这些模型与语言...
tldr: 该论文提出利用生成式3D世界模型自动生成多样化的仿真场景，使VLA模型能够在广泛的场景和物体分布上进行强化学习微调，从而同时克服真实世界RL泛化性受限和人工设计仿真场景成本高昂的难题。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that VLAs can be RL fine-tuned across broad scene and object distributions by leveraging generative 3D world models, overcoming both the limited generality of real-world RL and the high cost of manually designing simulation scenes.
